title: In Dialogue with Intelligence: Toward Insightful Co-Augmentation
abstract: arXiv:2505.22767v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Dialogue with a large language model can lead a person to insight: a sudden change in how they understand a problem. This perspective asks how model activity relates to insight as a dialogue unfolds. I propose that part of the intelligence expressed in dialogue arises from two interacting recurrences: each generated token becomes context for the next, and each response returns through the person, whose interpretation and new observations reshape what the model receives. Within this loop, the model's contribution shifts between modes, from echoing familiar formulations to offering a framing that opens a new direction for the person to develop. These modes may correspond to distinguishable patterns of model activity. A memory "spine" that selects which context is carried forward could elicit productive patterns again while the ideas themselves change. Public records of human-model dialogue, activity recorded from open-weight mode

translated_title: 与智能对话：迈向富有洞见的协同增强
translated_abstract: arXiv:2505.22767v4 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：与大语言模型的对话能够使人获得洞见——即对某个问题的理解方式发生突然的转变。本视角论文探讨随着对话的展开，模型活动与洞见之间存在怎样的关联。我提出，对话中所体现的智能部分源于两个相互作用的递归过程：其一是每个生成的词元成为下一个词元的上下文；其二是每条响应经由人返回，人的解释与新的观察重塑了模型所接收到的内容。在这一循环中，模型的贡献在多种模式之间转换：从复述熟悉的表述，到提供一种为个人开启新方向、可供其继续发展的框架。这些模式可能对应于可加以区分的模型活动模式。一个负责选择哪些上下文被延续下去的记忆“脊柱”，可以在想法本身不断变化的同时，再次引发富有成效的模式。人机对话的公开记录、从开放权重模型记录的活动……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出对话中的智能源于模型内部的词元上下文递归与经由人类反馈的外部递归这两个相互交织的循环，模型贡献会在复述熟悉表述与开启新方向之间转换，并设想通过记忆“脊柱”机制选择延续的上下文，从而在想法演变过程中再次激发富有成效的洞见模式。
en_tdlr: This perspective proposes that dialogue intelligence emerges from two interacting recurrences—token-level context recursion within the model and human-mediated feedback recursion—and suggests that a memory "spine" selecting which context carries forward could re-elicit productive, insight-generating patterns as ideas evolve.
